patterns.name: 汉语拼音 (pinyin of an underlined word)
patterns.structure: A sentence with one underlined 2-character word; choose the option giving its correct Hanyu Pinyin (4 romanised options).

distractorTraps.description: options differ in the initial: z/zh, c/ch, s/sh, n/l, q/x, g/k
options differ in the final: an/ang, in/ing, en/eng, ao/ou
same letters with a different tone mark (tone marks are often unreadable in OCR, so the share of pure-tone items is unverified)
a 多音字 is in the word, so the reading depends on context (seen less often; unverified)

example.stem: 他每天坚持跑步，身体越来越强壮。（画线词语：坚持）
example.explanation: “坚”读 jiān（第一声），“持”读 chí（声母是 ch），所以选 jiān chí。

patterns.name: 形近字／同音字辨认 (choose the right character)
patterns.structure: A sentence with a word missing one character; four single characters are offered and one forms the correct word in context.

distractorTraps.description: options share a component, e.g. 绝/觉/决 or 续/许/须
options sound the same or nearly the same but mean different things
a wrong character still looks plausible because it makes a real word elsewhere

example.stem: 爸爸工作很勤____，常常加班到深夜。
example.explanation: “勤劳”表示努力工作；荣、营、萤的字形和“劳”相近，但不能组成“勤＿”这个词。

patterns.note: Look-alike and homophone items are not separated: the OCR has no reliable tone marks and no answer keys, so which sub-type each item is was not counted.

patterns.name: 选词填空：近义词辨析 (near-synonym word choice)
patterns.structure: A sentence with one blank; four 2-character words of similar meaning or sharing a character; choose the one that fits the sentence.

distractorTraps.description: same general meaning but the wrong nuance or intensity
the word cannot go with the noun or verb in the sentence
two or more options share a character, e.g. 促进/训练/提高
a positive or negative word (褒贬) that clashes with the situation

example.stem: 这个小镇的空气很____，住在这里对身体很好。
example.explanation: “清新”形容空气新鲜干净；清洁多指没有脏东西，清楚指不模糊，清醒指头脑不糊涂。

patterns.name: 词语／成语的意思 (meaning of an underlined word or idiom)
patterns.structure: A sentence with an underlined word or idiom; choose the explanation that matches its meaning in the sentence (4 short explanations).

distractorTraps.description: the explanation covers only one part of the word
the explanation says the opposite of the word
the option fits the sentence topic but does not explain the word
the option explains a different word that looks or sounds similar

example.stem: 弟弟做事总是三心二意，难怪成绩不好。（画线成语：三心二意）
options: 做事不专心，不能一心一意
想了很多办法来解决问题
做事很有计划，一步一步来
example.answer: (1) 做事不专心，不能一心一意
example.explanation: “三心二意”形容做事不专心，所以选第一项。

patterns.note: Counts include some items where OCR lost the blank and the item is really a sentence-completion; the underlined word is not visible in OCR, so word vs idiom was not split.

patterns.name: 关联词 (conjunction pair)
patterns.structure: A sentence with two blanks (or one blank); choose the conjunction pair that links the two clauses logically.

distractorTraps.description: a valid pair of the wrong relation, e.g. 因为……所以 where the sentence needs a concession
the two halves come from different pairs, e.g. 因为……而且
a pair of the same family but a different strength, e.g. 即使……也 vs 不管……都

example.stem: ____天气多热，同学们____坚持完成了长跑。
example.explanation: “不管……都”表示在任何条件下结果都不变；其他三项的逻辑关系都不符合句意。

patterns.name: 句子选用 (choose the clause that completes the sentence)
patterns.structure: A sentence missing its first or last clause; choose the clause that fits the meaning and the connecting word.

distractorTraps.description: the clause contradicts the cause, result or turn in the given half
the clause is grammatical but about another event or person
the option starts with a conjunction that does not match the other half

example.explanation: 没带伞遇到下雨，自然的结果是被淋湿；其他选项或自相矛盾，或和前半句没有因果关系。

patterns.name: 词语运用：哪个句子正确 (which sentence uses the word correctly)
patterns.structure: The stem asks which sentence is correct; the same target word appears in all four sentences and only one uses it with the right meaning and collocation.

distractorTraps.description: the word is attached to an object or verb it cannot take
a word with several meanings is used in the wrong sense
a verb used as an adjective or the reverse
a positive word used for a negative situation or the reverse

example.stem: 以下哪一个句子是正确的？
options: 请大家保持安静，不要吵闹。
我们要保持这个好消息告诉妈妈。
弟弟的房间保持了新衣服。
example.answer: (1) 请大家保持安静，不要吵闹。
example.explanation: “保持”表示使一种状态继续不变，常搭配“安静、清洁、联系”；其他句子的搭配都不通。

patterns.name: 成语运用 (idiom used correctly)
patterns.section: 语文应用 / 短文填空
patterns.structure: Either which sentence uses a given idiom correctly (idiom shared by all four options), or choose the idiom or 4-character phrase that fits a blank.

distractorTraps.description: the idiom is placed in a situation it does not describe
an idiom with a positive meaning used for a negative situation
one character of the idiom is replaced by a look-alike (OCR makes this hard to confirm; unverified)

example.stem: 下面哪一个句子正确运用了成语“全神贯注”？
options: 上课时，小华全神贯注地听老师讲解。
弟弟全神贯注地跑出了教室。
球赛开始前，我们全神贯注地说笑。
妈妈全神贯注地忘记了关灯。
example.answer: (1) 上课时，小华全神贯注地听老师讲解。
example.explanation: “全神贯注”指精神高度集中，只有第一句描写的是专心做一件事。

patterns.note: Lower bound: only idiom items whose four options visibly share a 4-character string, plus 4-character option sets in the cloze, were counted. Idiom-meaning items sit under chi-pat-ciyuyi.

patterns.name: 短文填空：词语选用 (cloze word choice)
patterns.structure: A short passage of about 150-250 characters with 4 to 5 numbered blanks; each blank has four words in brackets and the context decides which fits.

distractorTraps.description: verbs or nouns of similar meaning, only one right for the sentence
attitude adverbs such as 果然/仍然/竟然/忽然 that need the passage logic to separate
a word that cannot go with the neighbouring word
the answer depends on a clue in an earlier or later sentence

example.stem: 放学后，我在公园里遇到了一只受伤的小鸟。我 Q1 (1 马上 2 一直 3 偶然 4 难道) 把它带回家，细心照顾。几天后，小鸟 Q2 (1 渐渐 2 忽然 3 难道 4 始终) 恢复了健康，飞回了天空。
options: Q1: 马上 / 一直 / 偶然 / 难道
Q2: 渐渐 / 忽然 / 难道 / 始终
example.explanation: 看到受伤的小鸟，“马上”带回家最合理；“渐渐”表示慢慢恢复，符合“几天后”。

patterns.note: Frequency is a lower bound: only papers where the cloze blanks were machine-readable (82 of 171) are counted; the cloze heading appears in more.

patterns.name: 完成对话 (complete the dialogue)
patterns.structure: A dialogue of 7 to 9 lines with 4 numbered blanks and a list of 8 phrases or short sentences; match 4 of them to the blanks by context. Four phrases are not used.

distractorTraps.description: an unused phrase repeats a word from the dialogue but fits no blank
a phrase that continues the topic but answers a different question
a phrase with the wrong subject, or a time that does not match the line before

example.stem: 小美：你怎么了，看起来很不高兴？ 小文：我的作业本不见了，Q1。
example.explanation: 小文在说明难过的原因，接着说明自己做过的事，只有第一项符合语境。

patterns.note: Observed format is a list of 8 phrases with 4 blanks (answers written in the booklet), not a 4-option MCQ; the 117-paper count is papers whose OCR contains the 完成对话 heading. Per-item types were sampled by reading about 6 dialogues, not parsed.

patterns.name: 阅读理解一 (passage MCQ)
patterns.structure: A passage of about 200-350 characters (a story, notice, email, letter or short expository piece) followed by about 5 multiple-choice questions with 4 statements each.

distractorTraps.description: the option changes one detail of the passage (a person, number, colour or time)
the option is true in the passage but does not answer the question
the option stretches one case to everyone or always
the option sounds reasonable but the passage never says it
the option says the opposite of the passage

example.stem:
每天放学，我都会到巷口的鸡饭摊买晚餐。摊主陈叔叔话不多，总是低着头切鸡肉。那天，我数了数口袋里的钱，只够买一份最便宜的鸡饭。陈叔叔看了我一眼，没有说话，却在饭上多放了半只鸡腿。我愣住了，小声说：“叔叔，我没有多付钱。”他摆摆手，说：“天气热，小孩子要吃饱。”后来我才知道，那天的鸡腿，正是他留给自己的午餐。从此，我每次经过那个摊位，都会停下来帮他收拾桌子，再说一声“叔叔辛苦了”。陈叔叔依然话不多，只是嘴角总会微微向上扬。

「嘴角总会微微向上扬」暗示了什么？
options: 他在笑话作者，觉得很好笑
他很高兴，只是不善于表达
他想催促作者，快点离开
他对作者的帮忙，很不耐烦
example.answer: (2) 他很高兴，只是不善于表达
example.explanation: 原文：「陈叔叔依然话不多，只是嘴角总会微微向上扬。」 (He is pleased but not talkative.)

patterns.name: 句子排列 (sentence ordering)
patterns.structure: 4-5 numbered sentences of a short paragraph in scrambled order; choose the option giving the order that makes the paragraph coherent (4 numeral orders).

distractorTraps.description: a time word (先/然后/最后/后来) or event sequence is reversed
a result is placed before its cause
a detail or example is put before the topic sentence
a pronoun or 这/那 phrase is placed before the noun it refers to

example.stem:
下面的句子应该怎样排列才通顺？
①然后，我吃了妈妈做的早餐。
②早上六点，闹钟响了。
③最后，我背起书包去上学。
④我马上起床刷牙洗脸。
example.explanation: 闹钟响了才起床；「然后」在洗漱之后；「最后」放在最后。

patterns.note: Syllabus-driven, not seen as a separate question type in the OCR'd papers: frequency 0. The word 排列 appears in the OCR text in only about 14 files, almost all as a vocabulary item (e.g. 排列整齐), not as an ordering task. Items are original.
